description.zh: Ctrl+Alt+滚轮按鼠标所在屏调亮度（可改修饰键；内屏 WMI、外屏 DDC/CI，都不可用时可用软件遮罩模拟），Ctrl+Alt+点击开关暖色滤镜；bright 关键字按显示器逐台调节
description.en: Ctrl+Alt+wheel adjusts the brightness of the display under the pointer (the chord is configurable; WMI for built-in panels, DDC/CI for external, and a software layer when neither answers), Ctrl+Alt+click toggles the warm filter; the bright keyword adjusts per monitor
